title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud — Episode4 Two Peas in a Pod

meta.Episode: Episode4 — Two Peas in a Pod
meta.Event Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Line: A few days later
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“Just wait.
I promise to find a star that will grant my wish.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
I really like the way you said that just now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You made this dog sound so kind. The way he comforted the boy felt so genuine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This dog really reminds me of you, Mochizuki.
I feel like your voice is perfect for him.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what MEI...
I mean, that's what Ichika and the others told me. This dog also reminded them of me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see why.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After actually giving it a try, I realized how difficult this really is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'd probably still be lost if you hadn't agreed to coach me, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you're saying that, since I'm no voice acting expert myself. I'm honestly stumbling around in the dark a bit here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You gave me a wonderful explanation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know that I have a lot to learn since my acting skills are still quite poor...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I plan on doing my best to make sure all those children go home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I wouldn't expect anything less from you, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because you're always working for the sake of others. Whenever you see someone in need, you never hesitate to jump in and help them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, my primary goal is to make sure the children enjoy this story...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that isn't actually the reason I decided to do this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It isn't?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I've never forgotten how moved I was when I had this story read to me for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember being so worried when the dog decided to set out on his journey to save the boy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And by the time he did save the boy, I was bawling my eyes out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see.
In other words, this story means just that much to you, yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It does. I quickly fell in love with picture books, and I discovered many more wonderful stories soon after.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like the children to experience the same thing I did...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember being really moved by this show I saw when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I first fell in love with shows, and I subsequently fell in love with singing and acting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had no idea...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At first, I simply wanted to become just like the lead actress I saw on stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But as time went on, that feeling transformed into a desire to make others feel that same sense of exhilaration.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's so wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean, that's basically what you just said.
So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like we're in the same boat here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
In that case...
I don't know if you'd be okay with it, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is it possible for people from outside your neighborhood to help with this event?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like taking part now after hearing your story, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! Having you there would make me feel so much better, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll need to ask the association for permission, but it shouldn't be a problem.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If we'll both be reading, should we divide up the roles between us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, if you wanna do that, then I have a suggestion...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think you should play the dog, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, you want me playing the lead...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. I know it won't be easy because there are so many lines, but I really do think your gentle voice fits the bill...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. Then, I'll do my best...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll also help out however I can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start dividing up the other roles.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I look forward to working with you on this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too...
